description: This file defines the interface ITransactionalStateFactory and the class TransactionalStateConfiguration related to transactional state management in Orleans framework, including configuration and factory creation methods.

classes.name: TransactionalStateConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for transactional state, implementing ITransactionalStateConfiguration, managing state name, storage name, and supported roles.

methods.name: TransactionalStateConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor initializing configuration with provided config and supported roles.

methods.name: StateName
methods.description: Property returning the name of the transactional state.

methods.name: StorageName
methods.description: Property returning the storage name for the transactional state.

methods.name: SupportedRoles
methods.description: Property indicating roles supported by the transactional state.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Method in ITransactionalStateFactory to create a transactional state instance with given configuration.
